perspective:
Angela’s available information:

- She is Angela Hwang, a hairdresser, and has been friends with Kevin Flores since high school. She knows Kevin works in construction and has seemed unhappy with his job.
- She invited Kevin to coffee. She heard Kevin say he was “alright” but stuck in “the usual grind.” After she expressed worry, he told her he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was just going through the motions.
- She suggested a different job or career path. Kevin said he had thought about it but did not know where to start and felt overwhelmed. She offered to explore options with him; he accepted and thanked her.
- She believed Kevin was considering a career change. She found and told him about job openings and a career counseling service. Kevin thanked her. She asked if he had thought more; he said yes, he was interested in something creative, maybe design or architecture. She said she thought he would be great and asked him to check the resources; he agreed.
- She believed Kevin was hesitant. Feeling frustrated and worried, she arranged a meeting with a career coach and told Kevin. He said she did not have to, appreciated it, but was not sure he was ready. She encouraged him to take a push; he agreed to give it a shot. She promised support.
- She believed Kevin was making progress. She checked in about the career coach. Kevin told her the coach was helpful, he had started online design courses, and he felt more confident. She said she was proud and offered more help. He said just knowing she was there was enough and he would ask if needed.
- She believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career. Feeling happy and satisfied, she organized a small celebration party. She told Kevin he deserved it; he thanked her and said he could not have done it without her. She said he did the hard work and invited him to enjoy the party.
- She has no access to Kevin’s private thoughts, hidden events, or narrator-only information beyond what she observed and what Kevin told her.
